model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if ETH-USD on Coinbase reaches a traded price of $6,000.00 or higher at any point before the market's settlement time.
- "No": Wins if ETH-USD on Coinbase does not reach a traded price of $6,000.00 or higher at any point before the market's settlement time.

Clarifications:
- "Reaches $6,000" means any single traded price (not a daily average or closing price) of $6,000.00 USD or above is recorded on Coinbase for the ETH-USD pair prior to the market's settlement time.
